events.title: Glenn Hoddle is sacked as England manager two days after his controversial remarks.
옥스퍼드 유나이티드's luck in the FA Cup runs out: 17-year-old Mikael Forssell bags a brace on his first start for 4–2 victors 첼시 in the fourth round replay at Stamford Bridge .
Tim Sherwood signs for 토트넘 홋스퍼 from 블랙번 로버스 for £4 million, and Silvio Marić joins 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 from Croatia Zagreb for $5.8 million.
더비 카운티 assistant manager Steve McClaren is named as 맨체스터 유나이티드's new assistant manager.
맨체스터 유나이티드 record the highest ever away win in the Premier League by beating 노팅엄 포리스트 8–1 at the City Ground . Substitute Ole Gunnar Solskjær scores four times.

February draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now top of the Premier League four points, although nearest rivals 첼시 have a game in hand. 아스널, 애스턴 빌라 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain bottom and are now ten points adrift of safety, while 사우샘프턴 remain in the bottom three but 찰턴 애슬레틱 have jumped clear at the expense of 블랙번 로버스. 선덜랜드 are still top of Division One, their nearest competition coming from 브래드퍼드 시티 and 입스위치 타운 who are level on points. 볼턴 원더러스, 버밍엄 시티 and 왓퍼드 complete the top six. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 그림즈비 타운 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 continue to keep up the pressure in the push for a playoff place.
